chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar said: He narrated to me Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari, who said: Al-Siyari narrated to us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Daqqaq al-Baghdadi,

I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (the second), peace be upon him, asking him about traveling on Wednesday, 'La Tudur' (the last Wednesday of the month). He (peace be upon him) replied: 'Whoever travels on Wednesday, La Tudur, to contradict the claim of those who consider it an ill omen, will be protected from every calamity, cured from every disease and ailment, and God will fulfill his needs.' I wrote to him again asking about blood-letting on Wednesday, 'La Tudur'. He (peace be upon him) replied: 'Whoever has blood-letting done on Wednesday, La Tudur, to contradict the claim of those who consider it an ill omen, will be cured from every calamity, protected from every ailment, and the place of blood-letting will not turn green.'

key_terms.خِلَافًا عَلَى أَهْلِ الطِّيَرَةِ: To contradict the claim of those who consider it an ill omen
key_terms.لَمْ تَخْضَرْ مُحَاجِمُهُ: The place of blood-letting will not turn green
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ لَا تَدُورَ: The last Wednesday of the lunar month

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on traveling or getting blood-letting done on the last Wednesday of the month according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Kisab* highlights the Imam’s practical approach to *al-Tiyarah* (superstition), encouraging believers to actively counter the fear of bad omens by performing specific acts like travel or *hijama* (blood-letting) on the last Wednesday. The narration emphasizes that such actions not only ward off calamities but also serve as a spiritual and physical purification, with the specific detail of the blood not turning green serving as a tangible sign of divine favor. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of using ritual actions to transform psychological anxiety into spiritual confidence.
